_comment: Currencies this deployment will accept on a payment request. The X9.150 payload format is
currency-agnostic and carries any code verbatim, but a deployment can only honour what its
payment rails settle. The US bank rails (FedNow, RTP, ACH) move USD. Solana settles USDC and
FRNT, the Frontier Stable Token issued by the State of Wyoming through its Stable Token
Commission — dollar-pegged, redeemable at par, and live on Solana among other chains.
All three sit in the same dollar peg group (pegged-currencies.json), so one QR Code may offer a
USD bank method alongside a USDC or FRNT Solana method. A code that is not listed is refused at
creation rather than advertised on a QR Code nobody can pay. Add one here when a rail that
settles it is added. An empty "supported" array disables the check entirely. This '_comment'
key is documentation only and is ignored by the loader, keeping the file strict, standard JSON.
